notes.title: Update Notes for June 14
notes.notes:
Roguelike Run System + Boss Fight! New Run System 
Core Trials is now structured as a roguelike.

Health carries over between levels, each dodge matters more than ever.

Includes a built-in auto-save system to preserve progress mid-run.
Boss Fight Added 
Tenezr is here. But is he the strongest boss you will ever face? Time will tell...

Learn its moves, dodge with precision, and survive the challenge to win it all.
Gameplay & Difficulty Tweaks 
Normal levels now end enemy attack phases after 3 attacks instead of 5.

Several enemy attacks have been redesigned.

Visual clarity improvements to combat animations.
UI & Visual Fixes 
General UI improvements across all scenes.

Major fix for broken UI layouts on non-16:9 resolutions.
Leaderboards
See how you stack up with the community on Steam Leaderboards!

Top scores get glory. Bottom scores get... sympathy.
What’s Coming Next Let us cook 
While bug fixes will be coming every now and then, the next big update is going to take some time. It'll be a major update that'll be build on features we've added and add lots of exciting stuffs.
Your feedback 
Your feedback has shaped this update. Drop your thoughts in our Discord, leave a review on Steam, or upload your wild gameplay on any public platform. We love hearing from you. We really do!
WISHLIST NOW! 
We're aiming for 10,000 wishlists! Every single wishlist makes a difference. Make sure every single soul that you know wishlists it, or else... Or else I will be very sad :(

notes.title: Update Notes for May 27
notes.notes:
“The Real Trial Begins”

Highlights

Combat System Revamp - No more timers. Dodge → Trial Master Appears → Hit them hard → Repeat. Simple. Brutal. Satisfying. What we want from you all is feedback to improve this system.
Full Localization Support – Now playable in Japanese (コア・トライアルズ) and Spanish!
Updated attacks – Refined attacks, New animations, and tuned difficulty.
More Sound Tracks – Upbeat chiptune tracks, courtesy of Wyver9.
Complete UI Overhaul – New UI, smoother setup, better vibes.
Bug Fixes – No more data related issues in the future. Hopefully.


Detailed Patch notes

Combat System Revamp

You now dodge a few attack waves, then the Trial Master appears.  
You deal damage by attacking directly with your core during this window.  
No time limit. Survive and strike until they fall.  


Full Localization Support

Japanese and Spanish language support added!
コア・トライアルズ welcomes its Japanese fans with full translations.
¡Y también, nuestros amigos latinos ya pueden esquivar la muerte en español!


Updated attacks

Every attack has been re-tuned for better feel and punch.
Stronger feedback, improved visuals, and tighter hitboxes.


More Sound Tracks

Added custom music for each level, hand-picked to enhance the mood and intensity.
All current tracks created by @wyver9.
More original music from commissioned artists will arrive in future updates.


Complete UI Overhaul

New Title Screen added – More user and streamer friendly. Tutorial is strictly optional.
Camera selection system improved – easily select your device from settings.


Bug Fixes

Player data has been reset.
This should resolve all corruption issues going forward.
Previous issues were caused by a dev (yes, it was Syncroxd, your Friendly Temmie). Oopsie Daisy Lol.


Tell Us What You Think
Your feedback has shaped this update. Drop your thoughts in our Discord, leave a review on Steam, or throw suggestions at us. We read everything. Sometimes twice.

What's Next?
This is our first big update! but not the last. More big stuff is coming soon. And when we say “next week,” we mean... hopefully. You've got a better shot at having a fish start flying than us meeting the deadlines.

WISHLIST NOW!
We're aiming for 10,000 wishlists! Every single wishlist makes a difference. Add it to your wishlist. It helps visibility and helps us continue development!
